pages.title: What Is the Higgsfield API and How Do I Get Started (https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/integrations/what-is-the-higgsfield-api)
pages.text: What Is the Higgsfield API and How Do I Get Started Back The Higgsfield API lets you generate video and images from your own code: one API key opens every model in the API catalog, and each request is paid in US dollars from a prepaid balance. No plan or subscription is involved: fund the balance, send requests at the rates listed in the catalog, and new requests simply wait once the balance hits zero. How is the API different from my Higgsfield plan? A subscription on higgsfield.ai and the API are two separate products with separate billing. Your plan, credits, and Unlimited access exist only on the website; the API runs on its own account balance in US dollars. How is the API different from my Higgsfield plan? Criteria Higgsfield plan ( higgsfield.ai ) Higgsfield API Who it's for Creators working in the visual interface Developers building generation into their own products Billing Subscription plus credits US dollar balance, pay per generation Unlimited models Yes, where included in plan Not applicable Requires the other No No Which models are available through the API? One API key unlocks every model in the API catalog: 50+ current video and image models, including Seedance, Kling, Wan, MiniMax, PixVerse, LTX, and Grok for video and Ideogram, Recraft, and Qwen for images, alongside Higgsfield's own Soul 2, Soul Cinema, DoP, and Marketing Studio Image. The API has its own curated catalog, and the selection may differ from the model lineup on higgsfield.ai . Every model has its own catalog page listing the current rate, supported resolutions and durations, sample code, a short overview, and a side-by-side table of similar models, so picking the right model doesn't require testing each one in code. How do I get started? Sign up for an API account, either as an individual or as a company. Register a payment method and fund your balance. Generate an API key in the console at open.higgsfield.ai . For security, the full key appears only once, so save it right away. Creating a key unlocks 20 concurrent requests. Connect through the Python or TypeScript SDK, or call the REST API directly from any language with an HTTP client, sending requests to api.higgsfield.ai . Each model page carries sample code, and if you work through a coding agent, ready setup prompts for Claude Code, Cursor, and ChatGPT (Codex). Full reference documentation, quickstart guides, and code examples are available at docs.higgsfield.ai . How is API usage billed? Billing is pay-as-you-go from a US dollar balance, and the minimum top-up is $5. Video models are priced per second of output and image models per image; DoP is the exception, priced per generation. Each model has a fixed rate for every configuration: the rate depends on settings like resolution and audio, is listed publicly, and stays the same regardless of how much you top up. An estimate endpoint returns the cost of a request before you run it. Funds expire one year after they are added to the balance. The balance can't go below zero: once it's empty, new requests wait until you add funds, or you can turn on auto top-up so production traffic never stops. You're only charged for generations that finish successfully. If a request fails, its cost returns to your balance automatically. How does generation work? Generation is asynchronous. You submit a request and receive a request ID, then track progress by polling the status or by receiving a webhook when the result is ready. Once the generation completes, you download the output file. How long are generated files stored? Generated output files stay available for at least 7 days after creation and may be removed from Higgsfield servers after that period. For long-term retention, download completed files to your own storage as part of your integration. Where do I see my API spending? Everything lives in the console at open.higgsfield.ai . Analytics shows spend and request volume over time and exports to CSV for reporting; Billing holds your current balance, payment methods, and invoice history. How is the API different from MCP and CLI? MCP and CLI are agent connections: they attach Claude, Cursor, or another agent to your existing higgsfield.ai account, and everything they generate deducts your plan credits. The API doesn't touch your account or credits at all: it runs on its own key and dollar balance, and it's built for shipping generation inside your own product. How is the API different from MCP and CLI? Criteria API MCP and CLI Account Separate API account Your higgsfield.ai account Billing US dollars per generation Plan credits API key Yes No Best for Building generation into your own product Generating from an AI agent See What is Higgsfield MCP, and how is it different from the web? and How do I access Higgsfield via CLI? Got any questions left? Is Open Higgsfield a different product? No. Open Higgsfield is the name of the API console at open.higgsfield.ai . The product, the catalog, and the billing are the same Higgsfield API. Can I use the API without a Higgsfield plan? Yes. The API works entirely on its own dollar balance. Having or not having a plan on higgsfield.ai changes nothing about API access or rates. Can I use content generated through the API commercially? Yes. Under the Higgsfield Terms of Use you hold the rights to use your generated content, so API outputs can go into commercial products, advertising, and client work. Can the API generate audio? There are no standalone audio models in the catalog. Some video models, including Seedance, Kling, LTX, and PixVerse, generate native audio inside the clip as a configuration option, which affects the model's rate. Can several people use one API account? Yes. Every account starts as a personal organization, and you can create a team organization and invite people to it. To switch between workspaces, click your profile icon and open Organization. Usage across the account shows up in the Analytics and Billing sections. I lost my API key. Can I see it again? No. The key is visible only at the moment of creation. Generate a new key in the console and update your integration. Do failed generations cost anything? No. Failed requests aren't billed, and the amount is returned to your balance automatically. Share Feedback Was this article helpful? Yes No Related articles What is Higgsfield MCP, and how is it different from the web? See how Higgsfield MCP works, and why it always deducts credits unlike the website. pages.title: What Is Higgsfield MCP and How It Differs (https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/integrations/what-is-higgsfield-mcp?fpr=lax-8e2251)
pages.text: What Is Higgsfield MCP and How It Differs Back Higgsfield MCP connects Higgsfield to AI agents. Connect once and generate images, videos, characters, and audio from Claude or any MCP-compatible agent, without leaving your agent. The main difference from generating on the web: MCP always uses credits. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on higgsfield.ai , so anything generated through MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, or other automated tools deducts credits at standard rates. What is Higgsfield MCP? MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open protocol that lets AI agents connect to external services and call their tools. Higgsfield MCP is a connector that lets you generate images, videos, characters, and audio from Higgsfield directly inside Claude or another MCP-compatible agent. It isn't the Higgsfield API: MCP connects to your existing account and uses your existing plan credits, with no API key required. For building generation into your own product with per-request billing, see What is the Higgsfield API, and how do I get started? Because MCP connects programmatically, using Higgsfield through it falls under the Developer Terms in the Terms of Use . In short: keep your connection secure, and you're responsible for anything an agent generates through your account. MCP connector URL: https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp How is MCP different from the web? The most important difference is credit behavior: everything generated through MCP deducts credits, regardless of your plan. How is MCP different from the web? Criteria Web ( higgsfield.ai ) MCP Unlimited model access Yes, where included in plan No, always deducts credits Free generations Yes, where included in plan No Credit cost Standard rates Standard rates Generations appear in Assets Yes Yes Access to models Yes Yes Do Unlimited models and free generations work through MCP? No. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on higgsfield.ai : they're intended for manual use, not for automated or programmatic generation. Anything generated through MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, or other automated tools deducts credits at standard rates. To generate on a model where your plan includes Unlimited access without spending credits, do it on the web at higgsfield.ai . What can I do through MCP? Image and video generation across the Higgsfield model lineup, with results saved to your Assets. Marketing Studio: paste a product link and get ready video ads built on a set of presets. Ad Multiplier: turn a reference ad and your product or character images into new versions of the same ad with a different product, location, hook, or CTA. Genjutsu: Motion Transfer, Object Swap, and Restyle for video. Upscale: raise the resolution and quality of your images and videos. How Upscale works on the website is covered in How do I use Upscale? Soul characters: train a character from photos and reuse it across generations. Higgsfield Audio and credit balance checks. Asset Library: browse your past generations and use them as references. For the full list of operations and how to phrase requests to your agent, see How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent? Got any questions left? Do I need a separate API key to use Higgsfield MCP? No. MCP connects through OAuth authorization, no API key is needed. API keys belong to the Higgsfield API, a separate developer product. See What is the Higgsfield API, and how do I get started? I have Unlimited access to a model, but MCP charged credits for it. Is that a bug? No, that's expected. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on higgsfield.ai , so generating through MCP always uses credits at standard rates. Does MCP work in other agents besides Claude? Yes. Any MCP-compatible agent can connect using the same server URL: https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp. In ChatGPT, use the official Higgsfield Plugin instead: see How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent? Third-party agents are governed by their own terms, and you're responsible for how they use your Higgsfield account. Where do my MCP generations appear? In your Assets on higgsfield.ai , tagged with the MCP source. For details and troubleshooting, see How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent? Share Feedback Was this article helpful? Yes No Related articles What is the Higgsfield API, and how do I get started? A developer API with 50+ generation models and pay-as-you-go billing in US dollars. How do I access Higgsfield via CLI? Connect coding agents to Higgsfield via CLI and Skills, no API key required. What external integrations does Higgsfield support? See every official Higgsfield plugin, from Figma to DaVinci Resolve, and what each offers. by Higgsfield Contents

pages.title: How to Access Higgsfield via CLI and Skills (https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/integrations/how-do-i-access-higgsfield-via-cli?fpr=lax-8e2251)
pages.text: How to Access Higgsfield via CLI and Skills Back CLI and Skills is how Higgsfield integrates with coding agents. The difference from MCP: MCP is a full connection for chat agents that exposes all tools with free parameter selection, while CLI and Skills is optimized for coding agents, where each skill has a defined structure that reduces token overhead and produces consistent output. Accessing Higgsfield through the CLI falls under the Developer Terms in the Terms of Use : keep your session secure, and you're responsible for what a coding agent generates through your account. Both use the same Higgsfield account and plan credits with no API key (API keys belong to the Higgsfield API, a separate developer product), and Unlimited models and free generations don't apply to either. See the setup guide and full skill list on the Skills landing page . When should I use CLI instead of MCP? When should I use CLI instead of MCP? Criteria CLI + Skills MCP Best for Coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) Chat agents (Claude web, Cowork) Token overhead Minimal Full schema per call Output format Structured through skills Agent picks parameters freely Credits Same account, same rates Same account, same rates Unlimited models No No API key required No No How do I set up CLI + Skills? Install skills: run npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills . This pulls three skills: generate, soul, and product-photoshoot. Sign in: run higgsfield auth login . No API key needed. Generate: in your coding agent, call /higgsfield:generate or say "Generate an image with Higgsfield." The agent picks the skill and runs it. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other agents that support Skills or MCP. What are the three Skills? generate , image and video generation from any Higgsfield model (Soul, Nano Banana Pro for images; Seedance, Kling, Veo for video), up to 4K. The agent selects a model automatically, or you can specify one. soul , train a Soul character from photos. The skill handles upload, training, and naming. See How do I create and use a Soul ID character? product-photoshoot , turn a product link or images into studio-quality product shots and video ads. Works for physical products and apps. Image presets: What are the three Skills? Preset What it generates product_shot Product on a neutral, studio, or catalog background lifestyle_scene Product in a real-world environment closeup_product_with_person Tight crop with hands or partial face and product pinterest_pin Vertical 2:3 Pinterest-native format hero_banner Wide-format banner for website, email, or campaign social_carousel 3 to 10 connected slides for Instagram or LinkedIn ad_creative_pack Coordinated set of static ad variations virtual_model_tryout Product worn or used by an AI-rendered model conceptual_product Surreal, CGI-style, or levitating product restyle Transform an existing image's aesthetic Video presets: UGC, Tutorial, Unboxing, Hyper Motion, Product Review, TV Spot, Wild Card, UGC Virtual Try On, Pro Virtual Try On. Got any questions left? What is the difference between CLI Skills and the Skills inside Supercomputer? Two separate systems with the same name. CLI Skills are installed via npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills for coding agents. Supercomputer Skills are built-in functions called with "/" inside the Supercomputer chat. They are not interchangeable. Do I need both CLI and MCP? No. Use MCP for chat agents like Claude web, and CLI for coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor. Which models are available through CLI? All Higgsfield models. The agent selects automatically unless you specify one. My reference images aren't being passed to the generation. What do I do? Update to the latest CLI version by re-running npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills . Earlier versions had an issue with passing references; current versions pass all references, including images, correctly. Do I need to reinstall the skills after updates? Run npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills again to pull the latest version. Where do CLI generations appear? In your Assets on higgsfield.ai , the same as web and MCP generations. pages.title: What are the official Higgsfield platforms? (https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/getting-started/official-higgsfield-platforms)
pages.text: What are the official Higgsfield platforms? Back The only official Higgsfield platform is the Higgsfield website ( higgsfield.ai ). The official surfaces also include Open Higgsfield, the Higgsfield API console at open.higgsfield.ai , the API documentation at docs.higgsfield.ai , the official Higgsfield MCP, the official Discord server, and Higgsfield's official social media accounts. If you found "Higgsfield" anywhere else, check it against the official list below. What are the official Higgsfield platforms? These are the core official Higgsfield surfaces: The Higgsfield website ( higgsfield.ai ). The only place to sign in, generate, manage your subscription, and pay. pages.title: What Is the Higgsfield API and How Do I Get Started (https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/integrations/what-is-the-higgsfield-api?fpr=adtestbench)
pages.text: What Is the Higgsfield API and How Do I Get Started Back The Higgsfield API lets you generate video and images from your own code: one API key opens every model in the API catalog, and each request is paid in US dollars from a prepaid balance. No plan or subscription is involved: fund the balance, send requests at the rates listed in the catalog, and new requests simply wait once the balance hits zero. How is the API different from my Higgsfield plan? A subscription on higgsfield.ai and the API are two separate products with separate billing. Your plan, credits, and Unlimited access exist only on the website; the API runs on its own account balance in US dollars. How is the API different from my Higgsfield plan? Criteria Higgsfield plan ( higgsfield.ai ) Higgsfield API Who it's for Creators working in the visual interface Developers building generation into their own products Billing Subscription plus credits US dollar balance, pay per generation Unlimited models Yes, where included in plan Not applicable Requires the other No No Which models are available through the API? One API key unlocks every model in the API catalog: 50+ current video and image models, including Seedance, Kling, Wan, MiniMax, PixVerse, LTX, and Grok for video and Ideogram, Recraft, and Qwen for images, alongside Higgsfield's own Soul 2, Soul Cinema, DoP, and Marketing Studio Image. The API has its own curated catalog, and the selection may differ from the model lineup on higgsfield.ai . Every model has its own catalog page listing the current rate, supported resolutions and durations, sample code, a short overview, and a side-by-side table of similar models, so picking the right model doesn't require testing each one in code. How do I get started? Sign up for an API account, either as an individual or as a company. Register a payment method and fund your balance. Generate an API key in the console at open.higgsfield.ai . For security, the full key appears only once, so save it right away. Creating a key unlocks 20 concurrent requests. Connect through the Python or TypeScript SDK, or call the REST API directly from any language with an HTTP client, sending requests to api.higgsfield.ai . Each model page carries sample code, and if you work through a coding agent, ready setup prompts for Claude Code, Cursor, and ChatGPT (Codex). Full reference documentation, quickstart guides, and code examples are available at docs.higgsfield.ai . How is API usage billed? Billing is pay-as-you-go from a US dollar balance, and the minimum top-up is $5. Video models are priced per second of output and image models per image; DoP is the exception, priced per generation. Each model has a fixed rate for every configuration: the rate depends on settings like resolution and audio, is listed publicly, and stays the same regardless of how much you top up. An estimate endpoint returns the cost of a request before you run it. Funds expire one year after they are added to the balance. The balance can't go below zero: once it's empty, new requests wait until you add funds, or you can turn on auto top-up so production traffic never stops. You're only charged for generations that finish successfully. If a request fails, its cost returns to your balance automatically. How does generation work? Generation is asynchronous. You submit a request and receive a request ID, then track progress by polling the status or by receiving a webhook when the result is ready. Once the generation completes, you download the output file. How long are generated files stored? Generated output files stay available for at least 7 days after creation and may be removed from Higgsfield servers after that period. For long-term retention, download completed files to your own storage as part of your integration. Where do I see my API spending? Everything lives in the console at open.higgsfield.ai . Analytics shows spend and request volume over time and exports to CSV for reporting; Billing holds your current balance, payment methods, and invoice history. How is the API different from MCP and CLI? MCP and CLI are agent connections: they attach Claude, Cursor, or another agent to your existing higgsfield.ai account, and everything they generate deducts your plan credits. The API doesn't touch your account or credits at all: it runs on its own key and dollar balance, and it's built for shipping generation inside your own product. How is the API different from MCP and CLI? Criteria API MCP and CLI Account Separate API account Your higgsfield.ai account Billing US dollars per generation Plan credits API key Yes No Best for Building generation into your own product Generating from an AI agent See What is Higgsfield MCP, and how is it different from the web? and How do I access Higgsfield via CLI? Got any questions left? Is Open Higgsfield a different product? No. Open Higgsfield is the name of the API console at open.higgsfield.ai . The product, the catalog, and the billing are the same Higgsfield API. Can I use the API without a Higgsfield plan? Yes. The API works entirely on its own dollar balance. Having or not having a plan on higgsfield.ai changes nothing about API access or rates. Can I use content generated through the API commercially? Yes. Under the Higgsfield Terms of Use you hold the rights to use your generated content, so API outputs can go into commercial products, advertising, and client work. Can the API generate audio? There are no standalone audio models in the catalog. Some video models, including Seedance, Kling, LTX, and PixVerse, generate native audio inside the clip as a configuration option, which affects the model's rate. Can several people use one API account? Yes. Every account starts as a personal organization, and you can create a team organization and invite people to it. To switch between workspaces, click your profile icon and open Organization. Usage across the account shows up in the Analytics and Billing sections. I lost my API key. Can I see it again? No. The key is visible only at the moment of creation. Generate a new key in the console and update your integration. Do failed generations cost anything? No. Failed requests aren't billed, and the amount is returned to your balance automatically. Share Feedback Was this article helpful?
